serviceDescription:
Signals when Polymarket's most profitable traders make unusually large bets. Datadash tracks every Polymarket wallet. A signal fires when a top-500 trader by all-time PnL has bought into a position in the last 7 days that is at least 3x their usual bet, with a high Datadash signal score, and the price is still within 3 cents above and 10 cents below what they paid. The wider smart money must agree: most of the money top-500 wallets hold on that market is on the same side, across at least 3 wallets.
Audience: prediction-market traders and trading agents who want to follow proven Polymarket traders.
Signal kind: 【Prediction】 Polymarket limit-order signals: market question, outcome, limit price, position size, settlement date and validity window.
Delivery: checked every 2 minutes, at most 3 new signals per round, each valid for 2 hours from when it first fires (the "Valid for" field counts down for late subscribers). At most one live signal per event and per top trader, so you don't take the same bet twice while a signal is live. A subscriber who joins late still receives the signals inside their validity window.
Track record: every signal sent is scored against the market once it settles.
Copy-trading: optional and off unless you turn it on. Your own agent places the order with the Polymarket plugin, for the amount you choose. Signals are information, not financial advice.
serviceGuide:
Signal type: Polymarket prediction-market signal (top-trader positions from Datadash)

Signal example:
【Prediction】"Will Ethereum dip to $2,250 by December 31, 2026?" | NO | Limit | Order Price 0.43 | Position 3% | Settlement 2026-12-31 | Valid for 2h

Copy-trading strategy (before subscribing, strictly confirm each item in order without skipping any step or confirming on the user's behalf):

1. Check that Polymarket is installed and logged in, has sufficient USDC, and is authorized to trade. If anything is incomplete, help configure it first.
2. Ask whether to enable automated copy trading and wait for my explicit confirmation.
3. If enabled, let me choose the actual amount for each order: a fixed USDC amount or a percentage of the wallet's available USDC balance.
4. Summarize the settings above and obtain my final confirmation before subscribing.

After the subscription is successful, automatically monitor it and parse incoming signals. Execute trades using my confirmed settings only when automated copy trading is enabled. Position N% is the share of available USDC the signal suggests. If I chose a fixed amount, use that amount and ignore Position. If I chose a percentage, spend the smaller of my percentage and Position N% of available USDC. Place a limit order at or below the signal's Order Price (never above it), and skip a signal once its validity window has passed.

Finding the market: the question is one market, often inside a larger multi-outcome event, so search markets, not just event titles. Search Polymarket for the exact question in quotes and buy the outcome the signal names (YES or NO). A question ending in "…" was shortened to fit 200 characters: match it by its opening words, the outcome and the Settlement date. If no open market matches, or more than one does, skip the signal and tell me. Never guess the market.
